note: Rejudged 2026-10-24 by an independent auditor (authored none of it). RFC 7432 Section 8.2.1, rfc/full/rfc7432.txt:1146: "The MPLS label in the NLRI MUST be set to 0." (the Ethernet A-D per ES route). STALE because a4fe1b70f3 moved generic attribute encoding (ORIGIN, MED, LOCAL_PREF and the rest) out of parseConfigRoute into the central config dispatcher; parseConfigRoute now emits only the merged extended communities. The label path is untouched: parseConfigRoute still calls l2vpnRouteToEVPNParams and then message.ValidateEVPNOriginationMode on params.NLRI, whose MAX-ET Type 1 branch refuses nlris[24]|nlris[25]|nlris[26] != 0 (update_build_evpn.go:260). Positives TestConfiguredEVPNPerESRoute and TestOriginEthernetADPerESUsesTypeOneRD compare the whole NLRI byte for byte, ending in the three zero label octets. Fresh overlay mutant 2026-10-24 (go test -overlay, the zero-label condition replaced by false, every other check kept): TestConfiguredEVPNRefusesInvalidPerESRoute goes red ("An error is expected but got nil") and TestConfiguredEVPNPerESRoute stays green, so the negative's "label 100" input is refused by this rule, not by its missing ESI. TestOriginEthernetADPerESRefusesLabelStack is byte-identical and its 2026-10-18 mutant result stands. Both config carriers pass on the tree.
